ONE AT A TIME (2026-10-26): `items` holds the single item in front of the PM, shown as "Do next"; `queue` holds the rest in order, and the page does not show it. When the PM finishes one, Dispatch moves the next from `queue` into `items`. At most 10 items and 3 P1 in all. NO INSTRUCTIONS ON THE PAGE (the PM, 2026-11-06: "I don't want the instructions in the dashboard. Only items to remember to do."): each item is one short line. Fields: p (1 do first, 2, 3), text (what to do, one short line), unlocks (a few words, the tag), due (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), url (where the steps live, an Issue or doc), added (YYYY-MM-DD). `how` is optional and never rendered; any how-to belongs in the linked Issue.
